newsitem.title: USA: Coram denies cuts claim against Medpartners.
newsitem.headline: Coram denies cuts claim against Medpartners.

text.p: Coram Healthcare Corp late on Thursday disputed reports it has reduced its claim against a unit of MedPartners Inc to $300 million.
Coram is suing MedPartners' subsidiary, Caremark International Inc, alleging fraud and breach of contract in connection with the sale of Caremark's home infusion business to Coram in 1995.

Coram said it continues to seek the return of the $309 million it paid for the Caremark business in 1995 plus interest and punitive damages. It said it also intends to ask a jury to award punitive damages, which it said could exceed $1 billion.
"Caremark's recent statement that Coram has limited its claims to $300 million is false," the company said in a statement.

Earlier on Thursday, MedPartners said Coram had reduced its claim against Caremark from $5.2 billion. MedPartners said the reduced claim was announced during a pretrial conference in San Francisco Superior Court.
MedPartners did not immediately return a telephone call seeking further comment.
